SPECIALLY FROM CHAITHANYA ♡ Like a Sister & Brother

Happy Birthday, Pragna Akka ❤️🎂

I honestly don’t know how to put everything into words, but I really want to say this today.

In these almost 1.5 years, you have become much more than just a friend to me. You are genuinely the only person I have ever felt like I could call my sister, and that place you have in my life is really special to me. ❤️

Thank you, Akka, for all the little things you’ve done, for listening to me, understanding me, supporting me, and simply being there. Some things may seem small at the time, but they mean a lot to me, and I’ll always remember them.

And I also want to say sorry. If I have ever said something, done something, or behaved in a way that hurt you or made you feel bad, intentionally or unintentionally, I’m genuinely sorry. I may not always realize my mistakes immediately, but I never want my words or actions to hurt you.

I’m also really happy for you that you got your job at Infosys and started this new chapter in Hyderabad. ❤️ You worked for it, and I’m genuinely happy seeing you move forward in life. I hope this new journey brings you lots of happiness, growth and beautiful experiences.

And honestly, we all miss you badly. 🥹❤️ Things definitely feel different when you’re not around. I really hope I can come to Hyderabad within the next month if everything works out. If possible, I definitely want to meet you. It would be really nice to sit together, talk properly, and spend some time like we used to. ❤️🫂

I’m really grateful that life gave me someone like you. I hope our bond stays the same no matter how much time passes or how much life changes.

On your birthday, I just wish that you always stay happy, peaceful and surrounded by people who genuinely care about you. You deserve so many beautiful things in life.

Happy Birthday once again, Akka ❤️🎂🫂

Thank you for being a sister to me, even though we aren’t related by blood. That bond means more to me than I can properly explain. ❤️

Once again, happiest birthday, Akka. Take care and keep smiling always. ❤️

Always with lots of love,
Chaithanya ♡
